incident-bot: Pager — High error rate detected on /v1/prompt-router/experimental (us-west-2). SLO error budget burn >50% over 5m. Oncall: alice. Priority: P1.

alice (oncall): ack — joining. pulling canary runbook now.

sam (eng): confirming spike from canary cohort canary-7, errors are 502/504 from model-proxy after the v0.9.3 rollout at 17:10.

jordan (sre): p50 okay but p99 tail up ~800ms. CPU on proxy nodes normal, but connection resets climbing. Dumping earliest logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T17:22:58Z] proxy-10.3.5.12 ERROR upstream 10.3.5.12:502 "bad gateway"
[2026-03-17T17:23:04Z] proxy-10.3.5.13 WARN kvcache miss flood, queue depth=452
```

taylor (platform): recommendation: flip feature flag for prompt-router-experimental to off (100%) to stop canary traffic. will run ffctl on +1. Confirm?

alice (oncall): do it. prioritize customer stability. Maya, stand by for support.

taylor (platform): executing: `ffctl toggle prompt-router-experimental --off --scope=global --reason="canary 502 spike"`

incident-bot: Feature flag prompt-router-experimental toggled OFF by taylor (platform) at 2026-03-17T17:27:04Z. Traffic routed back to stable prompt-router.

sam (eng): monitoring: error rate dropped ~92% within 2m of toggle, p99 latency returning to baseline. Some clients still reporting retries from earlier failures.

maya (support): prepping customer comms. which tenants saw the worst impact?

jordan (sre): aggregated tenant hits: acme-inc ~3% failed reqs, betaapps ~0.8%, test-plays ~0.4%. Most errors concentrated on sessions that hit the warmed kv cache boundary.

rene (solutions): looping in customer success for acme bridge. Maya pls send timeline + mitigation steps, I'll hop in.

alice (oncall): switching to responder -> responder handoff: taylor will lead remediation/rollback. I'm moving to incident watcher. @maya you're next oncall for post-incident followups.

taylor (platform): immediate remediation plan: 1) freeze rollouts, 2) revert PR #4822 (the proxy kv change), 3) deploy v0.9.2 rollback to canaries, 4) add KV backpressure gate + monitoring.

sam (eng): captured heap/profile and request traces for canary nodes, uploading to shared incident folder. Will include sampling key ranges and request ids.

maya (support): draft to acme CS ready, marking impacted window 17:10-17:27 PT. Will include mitigation (FF off) and next steps. Sending now. :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Notifying legal on potential customer-impact communication (no PII in initial draft).

alice (oncall): good work — mitigated. creating postmortem ticket and assigning to taylor+sams team to investigate root cause and prevention. If error resurfaces reopen pager.

taylor (platform): follow-ups: add automated circuit-breaker for kv cache flood, add canary health checks on warmup, and add a quick FF kill-runbook shortcut in Console.

sam (eng): will attach flamegraphs + repro steps to the ticket.

maya (support): CS note sent to acme, betaapps. monitoring CSAT and will escalate if they reply.

rene (solutions): prepping customer bridge notes. will join postmortem.

alice (oncall): closing slack thread for active paging. Incident state: mitigated -> postmortem required. Thanks everyone.
